verdict: M1794 closes the M1788 parameter, real-retired-identity replay, three-clock reset recovery, and elaborated-tuple source defects at the static level. It is not launchable: no one-shot runner/release pinning exists, and the mutation suite attacks only three parameter expressions rather than the replay identity/payload and reset-recovery obligations introduced by the repair.

findings.title: No uniquely governed one-shot runner or exact launch release exists
findings.evidence: Repository inventory contains zero M1794 runner files and zero M1794 release files. The M1794 contract sets every execution authorization false and merely states that a future separate exact-SHA release is required.
findings.risk: A manual VCS invocation would have no exact source/review/release binding, attempt latch, one-compile/one-sim budget, collision gate, no-retry rule, or atomic no-replace publication boundary.
findings.required_fix: Create an additive immutable one-shot runner and a future release schema binding exact runner, source contract plus seals, fresh review plus seals, docs359, all-false prelaunch claims, exact budget, unique attempt namespaces, no retry, and atomic publication.

findings.title: Mutation coverage does not attack the replay and reset-recovery repairs
findings.evidence: The author checker exercises three source mutations: minimum SOURCE_GROUPS, directed GROUPS, and production SOURCE_GROUPS. The 14 tests only search for replay/recovery tokens; no mutation alters replay slot, generation, tag, payload, zero-accept ledger, legal post-reset service, or SVA reset/terminal sequence.
findings.risk: A successor could retain the searched tokens while weakening a repaired semantic check. Contract SHA mismatch would detect changed identity, but it would not prove the checker understands and rejects the semantic regression.
findings.required_fix: Add fail-closed mutations for every saved/replayed identity and payload field, replay acceptance and sticky gates, reset length, full post-reset request/response/bridge/commit/terminal ledgers, and SVA recovery obligations.

required_next_gate: Create an additive successor that leaves M1794/M1795 immutable, supplies the missing runner/release governance and semantic mutations, and obtains a fresh different-author P0=0/P1=0 review before any VCS campaign.
